lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਿਮਰੰਥਿ ਗੁਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavahi gun baran chaar khat darasan brahamaadik simara(n)th gunaa ||
lines.translation: The four castes and the six Shaastras sing His Glorious Praises; Brahma and the others contemplate His Virtues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੇਸੁ ਸਹਸ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਰਸ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਧੁਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai gun ses sahas jihabaa ras aad a(n)t liv laag dhunaa ||
lines.translation: The thousand-tongued serpent king sings His Praises with delight, remaining lovingly attached to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavai gun mahaadeu bairaagee jin dhiaan nira(n)tar jaanio ||
lines.translation: Shiva, detached and beyond desire, sings the Glorious Praises of Guru Nanak, who knows the Lord's endless meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas gaavau gur naanak raaj jog jin maanio ||5||
lines.translation: KAL the poet sings the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Raja Yoga. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj jog maanio basio niravair rida(n)tar ||
lines.translation: He mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoys sovereignty over both worlds; the Lord, beyond hate and revenge, is enshrined within His Heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਲੇ ਤਰਿਓ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: srisat sagal udharee naam le tario nira(n)tar ||
lines.translation: The whole world is saved, and carried across, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਜਨਕਾਦਿ ਜੁਗਹ ਲਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi sanakaad aad janakaad jugah lag ||
lines.translation: Sanak and Janak and the others sing His Praises, age after age.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਯਥੁ ਭਲੌ ਜਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur dha(n)n janam sakayath bhalau jag ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed, blessed and fruitful is the sublime birth of the Guru into the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਬਿ ਜਨ ਕਲ ਵਖਾਣਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: paataal puree jaikaar dhun kab jan kal vakhaanio ||
lines.translation: Even in the nether regions, His Victory is celebrated; so says KAL the poet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har naam rasik naanak gur raaj jog tai maanio ||6||
lines.translation: You are blessed with the Nectar of the Lord's Name, O Guru Nanak; You have mastered Raja Yoga, and enjoy sovereignty over both worlds. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਛਲਿਓ ਬਲਿ ਬਾਵਨ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: satajug tai maanio chhalio bal baavan bhaaio ||
lines.translation: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, You were pleased to deceive Baal the king, in the form of a dwarf.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਘੁਵੰਸੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: tretai tai maanio raam raghuva(n)s kahaaio ||
lines.translation: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, You were called Raam of the Raghu dynasty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਕੰਸੁ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ਕੀਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: duaapur krisan muraar ka(n)s kirataarath keeo ||
lines.translation: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, You were Krishna; You killed Mur the demon and saved Kans.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਣ ਕਉ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਭੈ ਭਗਤਹ ਜਨ ਦੀਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ugrasain kau raaj abhai bhagatah jan deeo ||
lines.translation: You blessed Ugrasain with a kingdom, and You blessed Your humble devotees with fearlessness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug pramaan naanak gur a(n)gad amar kahaaio ||
lines.translation: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, You are known and accepted as Guru Nanak, Guru Angad and Guru Amar Das.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਜੁ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sree guroo raaj abichal atal aad purakh phuramaaio ||7||
lines.translation: The sovereign rule of the Great Guru is unchanging and permanent, according the Command of the Primal Lord God. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai ravidaas bhagat jaidev trilochan ||
lines.translation: His Glorious Praises are sung by the devotees Ravi Daas, Jai Dayv and Trilochan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਮ ਲੋਚਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamaa bhagat kabeer sadaa gaavahi sam lochan ||
lines.translation: The devotees Naam Dayv and Kabeer praise Him continually, knowing Him to be even-eyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਬੇਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat ben gun ravai sahaj aatam ra(n)g maanai ||
lines.translation: The devotee Baynee sings His Praises; He intuitively enjoys the ecstasy of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog dhiaan gur giaan binaa prabh avar na jaanai ||
lines.translation: He is the Master of Yoga and meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru; He knows none other except God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ਪਰੀਖੵਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੋਤਮ ਰਿਖਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadeu pareekhyt gun ravai gotam rikh jas gaaio ||
lines.translation: Sukh Dayv and Preekhyat sing His Praises, and Gautam the rishi sings His Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਛਾਇਓ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas naanak gur nit navatan jag chhaaio ||8||
lines.translation: Says KAL the poet, the ever-fresh praises of Guru Nanak are spread throughout the world. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਯਾਲਿ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਗਾਦਿ ਭੁਯੰਗਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi paayaal bhagat naagaad bhuya(n)gam ||
lines.translation: In the nether worlds, His Praises are sung by the devotees like Shaysh-naag in serpent form.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaadeu gun ravai sadaa jogee jat ja(n)gam ||
lines.translation: Shiva, the Yogis and the wandering hermits sing His Praises forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੵਾਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੵਾਕਰਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਅ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai mun byaas jin bed byaakaran beechaari ||
lines.translation: Vyaas the silent sage, who studied the Vedas and its grammar, sings His Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਅ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa gun ucharai jin hukam sabh srisat savaaree ||
lines.translation: His Praises are sung by Brahma, who created the entire universe by God's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਮ ਜਾਣਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahama(n)d kha(n)d pooran braham gun niragun sam jaanio ||
lines.translation: God fills the galaxies and realms of the universe; He is known to be the same, manifest and unmanifest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਿਓ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: jap kal sujas naanak gur sahaj jog jin maanio ||9||
lines.translation: KAL chants the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak, who enjoys mastery of Yoga. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi nav naath dha(n)n gur saach samaaio ||
lines.translation: The nine masters of Yoga sing His Praises; blessed is the Guru, who is merged into the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਧਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਜੇਨ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: maa(n)dhaataa gun ravai jen chakravai kahaaio ||
lines.translation: Maandhaataa, who called himself ruler of all the world, sings His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਉ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਬਸੰਤੌ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai bal raau sapat paataal basa(n)tau ||
lines.translation: Bal the king, dwelling in the seventh underworld, sings His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਥਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੰਤੌ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharathar gun ucharai sadaa gur sa(n)g raha(n)tau ||
lines.translation: Bhart'har, abiding forever with Gorakh, his guru, sings His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਬਾ ਪਰੂਰਉ ਅੰਗਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: doorabaa paroorau a(n)garai gur naanak jas gaaio ||
lines.translation: Doorbaasaa, King Puro and Angra sing the Praises of Guru Nanak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਿ ਕਲ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: kab kal sujas naanak gur ghat ghat sahaj samaaio ||10||
lines.translation: Says KAL the poet, the Sublime Praises of Guru Nanak intuitively permeate each and every heart. ||10||
